name: B10-0304/2026 (PPE) – Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the European Commission and member states to act. It condemns Russian drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland, and backs the right of member states to shoot down intruding aircraft. It asks for better counter-drone defences, a shared system for tracking drone threats, tougher sanctions on Russia, and more money for air defence and drone systems.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet in law; it is a set of demands to the Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** People and armed forces in eastern EU countries facing drones, jamming and sabotage.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to act on the requests.
